verdicts.line: Wave the flame. It spreads whatever color you are.
verdicts.quoted_chunk: Raise / wave the flame | ~2.5 | Clears fog locally; applies the flame's current alignment to NPCs in radius
verdicts.reason: Omits the fog-clearing effect entirely, making it read like any emotion-spreading mechanic in any game.

verdicts.line: Raise the flame — it clears the fog and pushes your current feeling outward.

verdicts.reason: The chunks specify 'NPCs in radius' not 'everyone who hears you' — hearing is not the mechanic.
verdicts.correction: The flame applies what you feel. Raise it to share that feeling with everyone in range.
